S1.publisher: battery-tech.net (trade news site), 'Hina Plans 10 GWh Sodium-Ion Battery Base in Wuhan'
S1.quote: Hina signed an agreement with Wuhan's Jiangxia District on October 14 to establish a sodium-ion battery production base ... with 10 GWh of planned annual capacity. The first phase will provide 3 GWh.

S2.publisher: Changjiang Daily (长江日报) via ctdsb.net
S2.quote: 近日，由陈立泉院士领衔的中科海钠科技有限责任公司全国总部及武汉汤逊湖钠离子电池研究院正式落户武汉江夏区，同步建设2GWh钠离子电池集成产线。

S3.quote: On July 9, preparation work officially began for the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) report ... for the 20 GWh Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Zero-Carbon Manufacturing Base ... in Zhangwan District, Shiyan City. Invested in and constructed by Hubei Wocheng New Energy Co., Ltd., ... the project will build four 5 GWh production lines

S4.quote: On the morning of May 8th, the Management Committee of Henan Xinxiang Power Supply Industry Development Zone held a signing ceremony for the investment cooperation agreement of the 2GWh annual production line project of sodium ion batteries with Zhongna Yingdian (Shenzhen) New Energy Co., Ltd.

S5.quote: a planned production capacity of 2GWhH ... Pingmei Shenma Group in Xinxiang lithium battery capacity will reach 3GWhH ... will be held in Fengquan District ... a planned construction cycle of 18 months
